### Problem and desired outcome

What task are you trying to complete? Describe the expected result and your current workaround using synthetic examples.

### Current environment

Source commit/tag or local archive version, platform/architecture, relevant coding app/version and workflow mode:

### Proposed scope

Describe a small useful change, its acceptance check and any local/cloud context implications. State any host, model, native capability or download assumption that would need separate proof.

Do not include credentials, private task contents, raw logs/databases or vulnerability details. Read the security policy (`SECURITY.md` in this checkout) for the current reporting limitation. A request describes a proposal; it does not authorize execution, provider spending or a workflow transition.
